description: Rotation/tornado validation cases for gridded-rotation work. Each case is a radar + UTC window from the public NOAA Archive-II bucket (https://unidata-nexrad-level2.s3.amazonaws.com/). Ground truth is SPC filtered storm reports (yymmdd_rpts.csv) plus IEM archived TOR polygons via tools/fetch_verification_truth.py. Keep windows tight: one supercell evolution each, 12-24 volumes max.

cases.notes: Quad-State EF4. Mayfield KY ~02:26Z, Cambridge Shores ~02:58Z. Strong long-track TVS expected near KPAH 60-120 km.
Moore OK EF5 19:56-20:35Z. Classic meso-to-TVS evolution, close range (~15-30 km from KTLX), tests depth/diameter gates.
Super Outbreak. Hackleburg EF5 ~20:15Z, Harvest/Hazel Green later. Multiple tornadoes + null storms in one window; good FAR test.
